card.name: Subject before a 'not' caveat
card.fires_on: The last word of a subject or clause just before a contrast or caveat such as 'does not ensure', 'and still', or 'even if'. It appears in drug-label warnings that say something absent or reassuring does not rule out a problem.

modes.label: Verb before not
modes.description: Verb such as does or be right before a negated or reassuring statement.

modes.label: Subject noun before caveat
modes.description: Noun ending a subject, followed by 'may' or 'have developed' type statements that run against expectation.
modes.example: patients who do not carry the HLA-B*5701<< allele>> have developed hypersensitivity reactions.

modes.label: Exception or qualifier
modes.description: Word just before an exception or hedge about severity.
modes.example: For other greater than grade 3 toxicities, except alo<<pecia>> and anemia, chemotherapy should be delayed

card.writes: It seems to favor words that continue a caveat and to disfavor words saying the effect is minor or temporary.
card.plain: It fires just before a warning that something reassuring does not rule out the problem.
